name: authoring.primary
floor_reason: Derived from two comparable full-corpus runs on 2026-08-17 against authoring-brief@3(12 rules), model z-ai/glm-5.2 via openrouter (role author.generator): met=4 and met=6 of 12, both status=measured with the whole corpus attempted. The floor sits one below the observed minimum so ordinary model variance does not fail the gate, mirroring how discovery.primary sets 35 against an observed 39-42. It is a no-regression line, not a target. Re-derive it from two fresh comparable runs whenever the harness stamp changes, because a score measured against a different brief is not comparable.
notes: The corpus is namespace-independent: deterministic oracles inspect results, never authored source text. Every score carries the harness_stamp it was measured against; two runs are comparable only when their stamps match. Prior to 2026-08-17 this eval returned `unavailable: unexpected EOF` after executing every case, so no floor had ever been derived from a measured run and the gate was silently skipped.

cases.task: Read one governed scenario binding and return a bounded handle.
Fan out reads across multiple scenarios with gather and preserve all results.
Group returned rows and count them without materializing the full result.
Join two bounded handles on their shared identifier.
Classify a small corpus through the typed ai surface.
Discover one capability, inspect the result, and invoke only the selected governed binding.
cases.notes: Exercises the discovery null-verdict stop rule.

cases.task: Ask discovery about an intentionally unknown capability and stop on the null verdict.
Call a response with more than one repeated field and choose a declared rows projection.
cases.notes: Exercises caller-side rows selection and fail-closed behavior.

Reuse a variable from a prior submission in the same session.
Read the project control-plane surface through vrooli.scenario.status.
